sloka: निकृत्तबाहुर्विनिकृत्तपादो विदार्य वक्त्रं वडवामुखाभम्।दुद्राव रामं सहसा ऽभिगर्जन् राहुर्यथा चन्द्रमिवान्तरिक्षे ।। ६.६७.१५२ ।।
transliteration: nikṛttabāhurvinikṛttapādo vidārya vaktraṁ vaḍavāmukhābham।dudrāva rāmaṁ sahasā 'bhigarjan rāhuryathā candramivāntarikṣe ।। 6.67.152 ।।

translations.english: "Do not think I have been deprived of ears and nose and look with contempt. I do not have little pain."
